_comment: Same as shadespp_hk_gpu_full.json, retrained with the reflectance-channel specular-removal fix (trainer.py now masks the reflectance channel with the same neighbor-averaged replacement used for `filtered`, instead of feeding the depth encoder a cleaned filtered image alongside an uncorrected reflectance channel). Trained under a new model_name so the existing v_hk_gpu_full checkpoint stays available as a fallback until this one is validated.
